steps.text: Oh... Well, there's the bell. A shame our lessons must always end so soon.
Some of you may have sneaked away before the bell rang, and a couple of you are having a nice nap on your desks, but there's nothing wrong with that.
'Commune cum Sclopetis' is a life-long course.
Now, my dear students, you have all obtained your guardian guns.
But have you thought about what they'll be guarding?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Oops, did I fall asleep...? Urgh.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: A call from the boss...?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Voice mail sounds about nice.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: AMBRIEL!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What is it, Captain? I've been at my post this whole time.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: 'At your post'? How many times do I have to tell you?! The Pontifica Cohors must act in a manner befitting the station!

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: On your feet! I won't have you lie on top of Laterano's holy walls! Next time I catch you sleeping on the job, you'll be sleeping in a saint statue's arms!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Wait, is that really an option—

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Don't you muck about with me! Don't forget, we are the guardians of—

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Laterano's honor, yes, yes.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Hmph. I hope you can actually take that to heart. Today's your last chance. One more mess-up, and you're out of the Pontifica Cohors!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: *sigh*
A watchtower.
This is where city guard Ambriel has found herself posted. A wide wall separates the business district from the leisure district, and attempts to hop the wall are frequent.
Her job is extremely simple: stop people from doing so. It is also extremely difficult, for none can hope to contain the free spirits of Laterano.
She nibbles on some chocolate, watching the Holy City's blue and white mingle and extend.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Bell tower, all clear. School, all clear. Business district, all clear.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Nothing unusual so far...
The guard scribbles her report into her terminal without a care before lying down once more atop the marble wall, staring at the clouds drifting overhead.
A thought has also drifted across her mind more than once.
This Holy City, tranquil, peaceful and unchanging—
Is like the sky reflected upon the land.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Where should I go this time after work...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hmm...
Ouch!

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: That hurt... Who threw that chocolate at me? I was so close...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Sorry, but this is off-limits.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Scaling the wall constitutes reckless behavior that not only violates the Pagus management law but also impedes the patrol duties of the Pontifica Cohors.

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Look, I'm just doing my job here. That whole spiel? Just repeating what my boss told me to say.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: If you have any complaints, you can go to the Guard offices to state your case, or file an appeal at the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: But if you have a justified reason, I could turn a blind eye.

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: A justified reason?

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: I-I'm in a hurry... If I don't hop over this wall, I'd have to circle all the way around the wall.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: See that side door over there? Should save you some time.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Just wait until my shift's over and take that door.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Consider yourself rejected.

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: Wait until your shift's over? That's no good, I'm definitely going to miss it!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Miss what?

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: I... I can't say...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Executing some secret will?

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: That's what I thought, you don't look the part... Transporting something important?

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Not that you look like a Messenger either...

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: I-It's something along those lines, though!

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: Anyways, this is really important to me! Today's my only chance!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You're laying it on a bit too thick here.

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: Sorry, I really can't delay any longer—

steps.name: Nimble Lateran
steps.text: S-Stop chasing me!

steps.name: Nimble Lateran
steps.text: Ah! Which way should I go... This way!

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: Please comply with the Notarial Hall and stop resisting your arrest!

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: Hmm? A fork in the road? Which one did he take...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: (Points to the left)

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: Aha! Gratias, Seniora!

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: So, uh, Seniora Guard, can I go now?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Wait a sec, I've got an idea.
A small alleyway.
The sun is beginning to sink toward the west. The shadows of the buildings cover half the alley. The perfect place to take a nap.
The guard covers her ears.

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: Your idea was blowing a hole in the wall with explosives?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Yeah. Anything wrong with that?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: The law says you can't hop over the wall. Doesn't say anything about opening a hole in it.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Why are you still standing there? I thought you were in a hurry?

steps.name: Anxious Lateran
steps.text: Multas gratias!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I think I'm going to need some help from an executor, Senior.

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: Certainly. It's the least I can do.

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: On April 27th, 16:27, a legal detonation was performed on a wall at the intersection of Panela and Souffle.

steps.name: Forthright Executor
steps.text: The completion of the process was witnessed by Notarial Hall Executor Richele.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Pontifica Cohors sniper, Ambriel, also ensured that no citizens or property were harmed by the blast.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: There, all done.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Thanks a bunch.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Don't mention it. After all, I was only able to catch this young fellow thanks to you.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hey. All I did was point the way.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hahaha, no need to be so humble, I know what happened.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The pillar that blocked his escape... you shot it down, didn't you? He would have slipped away otherwise.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The distance is most impressive. It's kind of scary to think that the Pontifica Cohors have such remarkable snipers in their ranks.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Wait, you think I'm impressive?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I'd say you executors who can handle things with your bare hands are the truly scary ones.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's hard to imagine a situation where you'd actually need to use your gun in peaceful Laterano.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hahaha, if I didn't use my gun, how could I win donuts at the dessert shop shooting competitions?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Well then, Seniora Guard, if there's nothing else, I'll be heading back to make my report now.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Thankfully, this hole serves as a handy shortcut.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hmm...? Wait, this road seems to lead right there.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: My, I never thought I'd make it in time today! No time to delay!

steps.name: Handcuffed Lateran
steps.text: Whoa! That hurts! Slow down!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What is this place everyone keeps talking about? How mysterious.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: AMBRIEL!!!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What is it now, Captain?

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: You better have a good explanation for why there's a big hole in the wall.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: About that... There weren't any violations. I made sure of it while I stayed at my post.

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Don't you get cute with me, you hear!?

steps.name: Voice from the Phone
steps.text: From now on, you've got one more assignment. Don't let anyone through that hole!
A city bathed in the golden glow of the setting sun.
As she places two traffic cones in front of the hole, Ambriel senses someone watching her.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Seriously, Captain?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I get that you need to supervise me, but do you really have to hide like that?
Whoever's hiding behind the tree carefully pokes their head out. When their eyes meet, the person quickly hides their face again.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: ...A kid?

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: D-Don't come over here!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Say, school's not out yet, is it?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: If you go back to class like a good kid, I'll pretend I didn't see you, okay?

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: D-Don't go, either!

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Just... Just stay right there...

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: I... I just want to look at your gun.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: My gun?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I guess you do look about right for the age when you'd pick your guardian gun.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Here, you can get a better look this way.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What, disappointed?

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Wh-Why...?

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Why... does it look like the ones the saint statues hold?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: Still haven't decided on a guardian gun?

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: We've shown you everything in our stock. If you don't like any of them, then maybe—

steps.name: Young Ambriel
steps.text: I want that one.

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: Which one?

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: ...The one that the saint statue is holding?

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: That's just a carving, though.

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: ...I get it.

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: It's a classic model. I should be able to find a blueprint. It'll take a while to make it though, so come back in a few days.

steps.name: Young Ambriel
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: It's nothing.

steps.name: Firearms Workshop Gunsmith
steps.text: Afterall, it's rare to see kids who look up to the saints nowadays.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I didn't pick my guardian gun for any particular reason.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's light and got a good range. That's all.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: A good range? But I...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Don't worry. You don't need crazy talent to shoot it, or some kind of lofty ideal.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's just a gun. You can pick one just like it.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: As long as it's what you want.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Sorry, I think you got me wrong.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: The books say the bullets of the saints are how the Law punishes people. If you get hit by one, it hurts really really bad.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: I just wanted to make sure if I sneaked through that hole, you wouldn't shoot me with that saint's gun, right?
After watching the child head back to school, the guard turns a corner.
The evening bells have not yet rung, and there are only a few pedestrians on the street.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Two scoops of chocolate ice cream, and sprinkle on some cacao nibs.

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Sure thing.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Not much business today?

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Tell me about it. Might be because the dessert shop on Panela's holding some limited-time event.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Limited-time event?

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Yeah. Apparently they're selling some sort of special-edition 'chocolate sunset mousse' just for today, and only until 5:30.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Special-edition 'chocolate sunset mousse'...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: 5:30 you say... Lots of people will still be stuck at work or school, though. They wouldn't be able to make it, would they?

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Even so, many people would rather take the leave to buy it. Can't compete with that now, can I?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Well, that explains a lot...

steps.name: Friendly Shopkeeper
steps.text: Here, make sure not to drop it. Thank you, come again!
The guard turns her head to see a manhole cover rattle through the corner of her eye. A strange sight, all things considered.
Hey, hey!
Is anyone there? Can someone help me?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: ...*sigh*

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Here, grab onto my gun and I'll pull you out.

steps.name: Embarrassed Old Man
steps.text: Oof, I suppose that's me saved...

steps.name: Embarrassed Old Man
steps.text: Hmm? This gun of yours... Where have I seen that model before...?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: ...Magister?

steps.name: Embarrassed Old Man
steps.text: Well, if it isn't Ambriel. It's been quite a while.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: I'm glad to see you've grown to become an outstanding city guard.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Why were you in the sewer...?

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Ahaha, well, I was communing with my guardian gun, just like how I used to teach you. Do you remember?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You mean that one class during detention?

steps.name: Voice From Outside
steps.text: My dad made a super-sweet shortcake! Who wants some?!

steps.name: Voice From Outside
steps.text: Oh, and who wants some honey cystymilkshakes from my family's shop?

steps.name: Voice From Outside
steps.text: Hey! What's the big idea? Give me back my chocolate! Give it back!

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: How long has it been? I'm so hungry...

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: If I boost myself up with this chair, I can climb out through the window...

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: Oh, good, it seems you really have learned something.

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: Magister?! I wasn't going to... I-I swear I won't do it again next time...

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: I understand. Detention can lock away the body, but it cannot lock away the spirit.

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: You used your gun to break the glass. I would say that's you communing with your gun.

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: I know it's against school rules, but I...

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: Do not worry, child.

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: The reason why guns are so important is because they allow you to come face-to-face with your heart.

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: And this is what allows Laterano to continue improving and become the paradise that guards its people's hopes and dreams.

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: Hopes and dreams...

steps.name: School Magister
steps.text: Tell me, Ambriel, what is it you want most right now?

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: I... I want...

steps.name: Student In Detention
steps.text: Chocolate.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Yes, yes, that's right! I hope you're not holding a grudge against me for keeping you in detention.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: But judging by that chocolate ice cream in your hand, I can see you haven't forgotten my advice.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Ah, you kind of ruined it for me...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: So, Magister, what kind of hopes and dreams dropped you into the sewer?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Is it really okay to leave your students alone and sneak out like this?

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Haha, look, this is my guardian gun. I was praying with it in the school's prayer hall when I sensed something calling out to me.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Following its guidance, I found a mysterious passage below the hall. When I reached the end, I saw light shining down from above...

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: I thought I was about to witness a miracle, but... as you know, I was stuck in a sewer, unable to get the manhole cover off way.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: That's a really nice mystery story you spun up, but you just wanted to get away from work, didn't you, Magister?

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: No, I think my guardian gun wanted something far simpler.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: All it wanted to see was the Lateran sunset today.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: But, if it so happens to coincide with a dessert shop's limited-time event, so much the better.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Figured.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: That excuse isn't enough to let you off the hook.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You're suspected of tampering with sewer pipelines, disrupting traffic, and scaling the wall outside of designated hours, albeit through the underground...

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Alright, Ambriel, I'll head straight to the Notarial Hall later to accept my punishment.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: But it would be a huge shame if I missed both a limited dessert and the most magnificent time of day in the Holy City.
At this very moment, new recruits to the Pontifica Cohors are marching in formation along the opposite side of the street.
The golden sunset falls upon their guns, the brims of their hats, and their young yet solemn faces.
Like maple syrup flowing across cystymilk toast, like honey drizzling over waffles.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Ah... I see what you mean.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: The light of the setting sun equally graces every corner of the Holy City. No wall can stop that.
The guard picks up her rifle, aims at the top of a distant bell tower, and takes a deep breath—
Pedestrians on the street raise their heads, those at home open their windows, and nearly every Lateran in the Pagus holds their breath in unison.
The bell tolls, and several fowlbeasts, their wings a gilded gold, fly across the clear, crisp sky.
A brief silence, then cheerful mirth erupts from the Pagus, carrying the hopes and dreams of its people into the evening air.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: 45 minutes and 19 seconds. That's how much earlier it is than the usual bell.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: And that's how much earlier the people of this Pagus will get off work.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: They can leave the office or school, and chat with their pals about where they're heading tonight.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: More importantly, they won't have to miss out on this beautiful sunset.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Ambriel, you let everyone out early so they could make it in time for the special event, didn't you?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Haha. I don't know about them, but there's still ten minutes left, so I can definitely make it.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Can we go together, Magister?

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Why of course.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Not going to answer that?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Nah, I'm done for the day.

steps.name: Spirited Old Man
steps.text: Now there's the troublemaker I know.

steps.name: Lateran Passerby A
steps.text: Strange, feels like the bell rang much earlier than usual today...

steps.name: Lateran Passerby B
steps.text: Wow! The sunset's beautiful!

steps.name: Lateran Passerby A
steps.text: I've got an idea! How about this day every year, we get out of the office an hour earlier!

steps.name: Lateran Passerby B
steps.text: I'm down for that!
The guard watches the setting sun poke out between the rosy clouds. The reflection of the Holy City in the sky blinks at her.
Before she realizes it, the street is awash with people coming and going. On this most ordinary of Lateran days, freedom and merriment fill the air.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Now this...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: This is Laterano's honor.
